How did Metallica draw a massive crowd in Moscow in 1991?
The legendary concert became a defining moment in rock history.
On September 28, 1991, Metallica performed at the Monsters of Rock festival at Tushino Airfield in Moscow, during a period of major change across the Soviet Union. The event featured several international rock bands and attracted an enormous audience eager to experience live music on an unprecedented scale.
